# factory-runtime-archive

Describe archive runtimes that have no language engine - a JRE, a standalone package manager, a generator jar.

An MCP engine. forge resolves it by URI and calls a tool over stdio.

```yaml
engine: forge://github.com/alexandremahdhaoui/forge-factory/cmd/factory-runtime-archive@v0.1.0
```

## Tools

| Tool | Does | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `describe` | Answer the runtime's artifacts, layout, env and prerequisites from the engine's table. Pure data. | `DescribeInput` | `RuntimeDescription` |

## Running it by hand

```sh
go run ./cmd/factory-runtime-archive --mcp
```

It speaks JSON-RPC on stdin and stdout. Logs go to stderr, because
anything else corrupts the stream.
